title: Placement Officer
description:
Company: Proxima Skills Academy

Designation: Placement Officer

Department: Training & Placement

Experience: 2–3 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Location: Kolkata

Reporting To: Placement Manager / Management

**1. Job Overview**

Proxima Skills Academy is looking for a proactive, result-oriented and career-focused Placement Officer to manage student placement activities and develop strong relationships with corporate employers, recruitment agencies, CROs, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, hospitals and healthcare organizations.

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating student placements, identifying job opportunities, sourcing relevant vacancies, building corporate relationships, preparing students for interviews and facilitating successful placement outcomes.

The ideal candidate should have good communication, networking, coordination and recruitment skills, with the ability to manage placement operations and achieve defined placement targets.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Corporate Relations & Employer Development**

* Identify and establish relationships with companies, CROs, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, hospitals, healthcare institutions and clinical research organizations.
* Develop and maintain a database of corporate HR contacts, recruiters and hiring managers.
* Connect with HR professionals, Talent Acquisition teams and recruitment consultants to explore hiring opportunities.
* Develop new corporate partnerships for student placement opportunities.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with existing hiring partners to obtain active job requirements.
* Build long-term relationships with organizations for continuous placement opportunities.
* Explore recruitment opportunities across PAN India.

**B. Job Opportunities & Vacancy Management**

* Identify relevant job openings for students and trained candidates.
* Source vacancies through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, company career portals and recruitment networks.
* Collect and maintain updated Job Descriptions (JDs) from hiring organizations.
* Identify suitable candidates based on educational qualifications, skills, experience and job requirements.
* Share relevant candidate profiles with prospective employers.
* Maintain an updated database of active job openings, employer details and application status.
* Track interview schedules, selection updates, offer letters and joining status.

**C. Student Placement Coordination**

* Coordinate with students regarding placement eligibility, job preferences and career requirements.
* Maintain an updated database of placement-eligible students.
* Collect and verify student resumes, academic details and relevant documentation.
* Guide students in preparing professional resumes and optimizing their LinkedIn profiles.
* Conduct or coordinate mock interviews and interview preparation sessions.
* Share relevant job opportunities with eligible students.
* Prepare and forward shortlisted candidate profiles to hiring companies.
* Coordinate interview schedules between students and employers.
* Collect interview feedback and communicate selection or rejection updates.
* Follow up with selected candidates until successful joining.
* Collect joining confirmations and relevant placement proof.

**D. Recruitment & Interview Coordination**

* Understand employer requirements and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Screen student profiles against job specifications.
* Coordinate virtual and face-to-face interviews.
* Ensure candidates are adequately informed about interview schedules, job roles and employer expectations.
* Follow up with HR teams for interview feedback and selection decisions.
* Coordinate offer letter communication and joining formalities.
* Maintain records of candidate applications, interviews, selections and joining status.

**E. Placement Database & MIS Management**

* Maintain accurate student placement databases and employer databases.
* Track job opportunities, profiles shared, interview calls, selections and successful placements.
* Maintain company-wise and programme-wise placement reports.
* Update student placement status in the designated CRM or Google Sheets.
* Maintain records of employer communications, JDs, interview feedback and offer letters.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly placement performance reports.
* Ensure 100% accuracy and timely updating of placement-related information.

**F. Student Career Support & Coordination**

* Guide students regarding relevant job opportunities based on their qualifications and skills.
* Coordinate with trainers to understand students' technical competencies and job readiness.
* Identify skill gaps and communicate training requirements to the academic team.
* Support students in interview preparation, professional communication and career planning.
* Collect student feedback regarding placement services and interview experiences.
* Coordinate placement drives, recruitment events and employer interaction sessions.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Life Sciences or any relevant discipline.
* 2–3 years of experience in Placement Coordination, Recruitment, HR or Talent Acquisition.
* Experience in corporate relationship management and employer networking.
* Knowledge of recruitment portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn and Indeed.
* Good understanding of recruitment processes, job descriptions and candidate screening.
* Strong communication, negotiation and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple job requirements and candidate profiles simultaneously.
* Strong follow-up and relationship management skills.
* Target-oriented and result-driven approach.

description:
**Location:**
Industrial Area, Kanakapura Road, Bangalore

**Work arrangement:**
Full-time, on-site; six-day working week

**Experience:**
6–10 years, including substantial experience in plant HR

**About Leumas**

Leumas is building advanced manufacturing technologies for pharma and allied industries to make manufacturing more personalised, economical and distributed. Our teams bring together engineering, science and factory operations to build and run modular manufacturing systems.

As we expand, we’re looking for a hands-on HR professional who can strengthen factory culture, drive accountability and keep our people processes and compliance practices ready for scale.

**About the Role**

You will own plant HR operations, employee relations, workforce discipline, performance tracking and factory and labour compliance coordination.

Working closely with plant leadership and department heads, you will help build a factory where expectations are clear, performance is measured, employees are treated fairly and issues are resolved promptly. You will also coordinate audit readiness across departments and ensure compliance actions are followed through to closure.

Recruitment and hiring are outside the scope of this role.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Factory Culture and Discipline**

* Build a culture of punctuality, accountability, respectful behaviour and consistent adherence to plant procedures.
* Maintain a regular shop-floor presence and understand concerns across employees, supervisors and contract workers.
* Ensure workplace rules are communicated clearly and applied fairly across teams and shifts.
* Address absenteeism, repeated misconduct and disciplinary issues through documented processes.
* Work with managers to reinforce expected behaviours and resolve recurring workforce issues.

**2. Performance Measurement and Tracking**

* Work with department heads to define measurable KRAs, KPIs and role expectations.
* Maintain performance scorecards and track review completion, agreed targets and overdue actions.
* Coordinate probation reviews, periodic performance discussions and performance improvement plans.
* Ensure performance concerns are supported by evidence, communicated clearly and followed up.
* Present a regular people and performance dashboard to leadership, highlighting gaps and required interventions.

**3. Factory and Labour Compliance**

* Own the compliance calendar for factory and labour matters, coordinating with consultants and relevant departments.
* Track applicable registrations, licences, renewals, returns, registers and statutory records.
* Verify contractor documentation relating to worker deployment, wages and applicable statutory contributions.
* Coordinate inspections, notices and compliance queries with management and authorised advisers.
* Maintain an action tracker with clear owners and deadlines, escalating gaps before they become overdue.

**4. Facility Audit Readiness**

* Coordinate ongoing facility readiness for statutory, customer and internal audits.
* Work with Production, Quality, EHS, Engineering and Administration to maintain required records and workplace practices.
* Keep employee files, attendance and wage records, training records, contractor documents and compliance evidence organised and accessible.
* Conduct periodic readiness checks with department owners and track observations through to closure.
* Ensure audit readiness is part of routine operations, with technical and quality requirements owned by the respective functions.

**5. Attendance, Payroll and Employee Records**

* Maintain accurate attendance, shift, overtime, leave and employee records.
* Prepare and verify payroll inputs with Finance and the payroll team.
* Resolve attendance and salary discrepancies promptly.
* Coordinate employee movements, exits and full-and-final settlement inputs.
* Maintain accurate information in Zoho People, Zoho Payroll or equivalent systems.

**6. Contract Workforce and Employee Relations**

* Coordinate daily workforce deployment and attendance with contractors and plant supervisors.
* Address contract workforce issues and monitor contractor adherence to agreed requirements.
* Serve as an accessible point of contact for employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Support employee welfare, communication and retention.
* Handle sensitive matters with confidentiality, fairness and sound judgement.

**7. Onboarding and Exit Formalities**

* Manage post-selection joining formalities, employee documentation and HRMS enrolment.
* Ensure appointment letters, policy acknowledgements, confidentiality agreements and other required documents are completed.
* Coordinate employee IDs, attendance registration and access requirements with relevant teams.
* Manage resignation records, notice-period tracking, handover completion and departmental clearances.
* Coordinate asset returns and timely access removal with Administration and IT.
* Prepare and verify full-and-final settlement inputs with Finance, coordinate exit documentation and conduct exit discussions where appropriate.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong plant HR experience in manufacturing, preferably pharma, nutraceuticals, food, cosmetics or a comparable environment.
* Direct experience managing permanent employees and contract workers across shifts.
* Practical experience with factory and labour compliance, inspections and audit preparation.
* Experience implementing performance scorecards, review processes and improvement plans.
* Confidence handling employee grievances and disciplinary matters fairly and consistently.
* Strong documentation, follow-through, Excel and HRMS skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively in Kannada and English; Hindi is an advantage.
* A degree in HR, business administration or a related discipline; a postgraduate HR qualification is preferred.

**Working at Leumas**

We are a growing company that requires initiative, adaptability and strong ownership. You should be comfortable working closely with shop-floor teams, addressing issues directly and building practical systems while managing daily operations. We expect you to follow through, hold people accountable and help create a disciplined, respectful and performance-driven workplace.

**Why Join Us**

* Shape the factory culture and people practices of a growing manufacturing company.
* Work closely with plant leadership and the founding team.
* Build systems that improve workforce accountability, performance and compliance.
* Grow your responsibilities as Leumas expands its facilities and teams.

description:
**Job Description – Production & Operations Manager**

**Role Overview**

**The role is responsible for the complete planning, technical execution, and production management of events.**

**The role demands comprehensive knowledge of event production, fabrication, technical systems, materials, venue, procurement, budgeting and on-ground execution. The individual must independently evaluate production requirements, recommend technical solutions, prepare execution plans, and lead production decisions without depending on vendors for technical guidance or execution strategy.**

**The ideal candidate should be capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, working under tight timelines, and handling overnight installations and event setups whenever required.**

**# Key Responsibilities**

**Brief Analysis & Production Planning**

**\* Understand briefs and translate concepts into technically feasible production plans.**

**\* Prepare detailed production requirement checklists and execution roadmaps.**

**\* Develop Bills of Quantities (BOQs) covering fabrication, branding, AV, décor, electricals, furniture, logistics, and event infrastructure.**

**\* Prepare detailed production schedules, setup timelines, dismantling plans, and execution milestones.**

**\* Plan production requirements proactively while anticipating operational challenges and technical constraints.**

**Technical Planning**

**\* Possess complete technical knowledge of event production, including staging, trussing, rigging, LED systems, lighting, audio, video, power distribution, electrical planning, structures, fabrication techniques, branding systems, and event infrastructure.**

**\* Prepare technical layouts covering stage positioning, LED placement, cable routing, power distribution, branding locations, audience flow, backstage operations, and engagement zones.**

**\* Conduct technical feasibility & checks before production begins.**

**\* Work closely with the design team to ensure concepts are practical, structurally sound, cost-effective, and executable.**

**Fabrication & Event Infrastructure**

**\* Plan, supervise, and execute fabrication of stages, backdrops, exhibition booths, kiosks, experiential installations, any other branding structures, and décor elements.**

**\* Recommend appropriate production materials, finishes, fabrication methods, and structural solutions.**

**\* Ensure fabrication quality, safety, durability, and finishing standards throughout production.**

**Costing, Budgeting & Procurement**

**\* Prepare detailed production cost estimates and budgets.**

**\* Source quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and optimize costs while maintaining quality.**

**\* ⁠Identify and procure all materials, rentals, technical equipment, fabrication requirements, branding elements, décor, furniture and event infrastructure.**

**\* Maintain complete ownership of production procurement from planning through delivery.**

**Vendor Management**

**\* Develop and manage a reliable network of fabrication, AV, lighting, sound, printing, logistics, décor, venue, rental, and technical vendors.**

**\* Evaluate vendors based on capability, pricing, quality, and delivery timelines.**

**\* Monitor vendor performance and ensure timely execution of deliverables.**

**\* Direct vendors based on internal production plans rather than relying on vendor recommendations.**

**Venue Knowledge & Coordination**

**\* Possess strong knowledge of corporate venues, hotels, convention centres, exhibition spaces, outdoor venues, and event infrastructure.**

**\* Conduct venue recce to assess loading access, rigging points, ceiling heights, electrical capacity, staging feasibility, backstage movement, emergency exits, and technical infrastructure.**

**\* Recommend production methodologies best suited for each venue.**

**Technical Coordination**

**\* Coordinate all technical production including LED walls, projection systems, sound reinforcement, lighting rigs, presentation systems, networking requirements, show control, and electrical distribution.**

**\* Conduct technical rehearsals, cue-to-cue testing, presentation testing, sound checks, and equipment validation before show time.**

**Event Logistics**

**\* Plan transportation, warehousing, dispatch schedules, loading, unloading, installation, and movement of production materials and technical equipment.**

**\* Coordinate manpower deployment and equipment scheduling for efficient event setup.**

**Event Execution**

**\* Lead complete on-ground production and technical execution.**

**\* Supervise fabrication teams, technicians, electricians, AV engineers, riggers, carpenters, installers, logistics personnel, and production crew.**

**\* Ensure all production, branding, and technical elements are installed and operational before event commencement.**

**\* Resolve technical and operational issues in real time during setup and live events.**

**Show Flow & Cue Management**

**\* Prepare detailed production schedules, show flow documents, cue sheets, technical running orders, and execution timelines.**

**\* Coordinate closely with client servicing, creative, design, and technical teams to ensure seamless event delivery.**

**\* Ensure every production activity is pre-planned with clearly defined responsibilities and execution timelines.**

**Innovation & knowledge on trends**

**\* Stay updated on new production technologies, fabrication techniques, experiential formats, materials, equipment, and industry trends.**

**\* Recommend innovative production solutions that improve efficiency, quality, and audience experience.**

**Risk Management & Compliance**

**\* Ensure compliance with venue regulations, safety standards, structural guidelines, and operational best practices.**

**\* Identify production risks in advance and implement contingency plans to ensure uninterrupted execution.**

**Post-Event Responsibilities**

**\* Supervise dismantling, material recovery, venue clearance, and return of hired equipment.**

**\* Complete vendor closures and production reconciliations.**

* **\* Prepare post-event reports, operational reviews, and recommendations for process improvements.**

**Business & Team:**

Everyday Banking sits at the heart of how millions of customers interact with CommBank every day. Technology enables customers to manage their money simply, safely and reliably, and our engineering teams are central to creating experiences and platforms that customers can depend on.

We are looking for an Engineering Executive Manager to lead our Everyday Banking engineering organisation in Bengaluru. This is a senior technology and people leadership role with responsibility for approximately 150 engineers across levels. You will create the environment, capability and engineering systems that enable teams to deliver meaningful customer and enterprise outcomes at scale.

This is not a role defined by geography or by people management alone. You will be an integral member of the Everyday Banking technology leadership community, working across Bengaluru and Australia to strengthen engineering capability, improve technology health and delivery effectiveness, and help shape how the domain turns strategy into outcomes.

  

**Impact & contribution:**

* **Own engineering outcomes –** Translate Everyday Banking priorities into clear engineering outcomes and ensure teams understand the customer and business problems they are solving. Stay engaged from intent through execution and measurable value, rather than treating delivery as a hand-off.
* **Lead a high-performing engineering organisation –** Build, lead and inspire an engaged organisation of approximately 150 engineers. Establish clear expectations, strong leadership layers and an environment of accountability, psychological safety, constructive challenge and continuous improvement.
* **Exercise technology and engineering leadership –** Bring credible technical judgement to domain conversations. Understand the architecture, technology health and engineering constraints of the area you lead; challenge decisions constructively; identify systemic issues; and partner with CTLs and senior technical leaders to improve technology direction and execution.
* **Build engineering excellence –** Create engineering systems that improve flow, quality and safe speed. Champion DevSecOps, full-cycle engineering, automation, continuous delivery, observability, reliability, resilience, security and production ownership, using measures to drive sustained improvement.
* **Improve technology health –** Make technical debt, obsolescence, operational risk and engineering friction visible. Work with technology and product leaders to prioritise remediation proportionately, simplify the estate, increase reuse and automation, and avoid short-term delivery choices that create unsustainable complexity.
* **Create autonomous, accountable teams –** Reduce unnecessary dependencies and decision bottlenecks. Establish clear guardrails and decision rights so teams and senior engineers can make sound decisions close to the work while remaining aligned to enterprise standards and domain direction.
* **Grow leaders and technical capability –** Build a strong pipeline of Engineering Managers, Principal/Staff Engineers and future technology leaders. Provide candid coaching and feedback, create meaningful development and succession plans, and establish mechanisms for peer learning, mentoring and technical communities.
* **Lead through others –** Create leverage by developing leaders who can independently own people, technology and delivery outcomes. Deliberately avoid becoming the escalation point or technical dependency for every important decision.
* **Influence and co-lead globally –** Build trusted relationships across Bengaluru and Australia. Bring a point of view, influence without relying on hierarchy, challenge constructively and create shared accountability with Product, Business and Technology partners. Help Bengaluru teams participate in shaping decisions, not simply receiving them.
* **Drive delivery with engineering discipline –** Where you carry delivery accountability, translate priorities into executable plans, manage material dependencies and risks, and deliver predictably while protecting quality, resilience and long-term technology health. Where delivery accountability sits elsewhere, remain an active partner in removing systemic blockers and improving execution.
* **Accelerate AI-enabled engineering –** Drive responsible adoption of AI across the software engineering lifecycle where it improves developer effectiveness, quality, operational efficiency or customer outcomes. Establish appropriate controls, measurement and learning so adoption creates durable value.
* **Lead risk and operational ownership –** Ensure teams understand and own the technology they build and run. Strengthen service health, incident learning, vulnerability management, production readiness, lifecycle management and compliance with security, privacy, resilience and risk expectations.
* **Shape workforce and capability strategy –** Partner with domain and India leadership on workforce composition, location strategy, critical skills, hiring and capability investment so the organisation has the capacity and skills required for the future.
* **Strengthen the wider Retail Technology community –** Contribute beyond Everyday Banking by sharing practices, developing talent, solving common engineering problems and helping Retail Technology India become a distinctive engineering advantage for the Bank.
* **Reporting lines:**
* **Functional reporting –** Everyday Banking Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager, with accountability into the domain for engineering outcomes, capability, technology health and execution.
* **Local reporting –** General Manager, Retail Technology India, with accountability for local leadership, talent, culture, workforce health and the broader Bengaluru technology community.
* **Leadership scope –** Approximately 150 engineers across levels and disciplines, led through a layer of senior engineering and people leaders. The exact structure may evolve with the needs of the domain.
* **Delivery accountability –** The role may carry direct delivery accountability for selected outcomes or portfolios. Irrespective of formal delivery ownership, you are expected to actively influence prioritization, dependencies, risks and execution across the domain.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* You will lead a large, diverse engineering organisation spanning multiple crews & squads, engineering leaders and technical disciplines. You will partner closely with the Everyday Banking Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager, Crew Tech Leads, Product and Business leaders, Architects, Chief and Principal Engineers, and enterprise technology functions.
* The Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager remains accountable for the overall technology direction of Everyday Banking. Your role is to translate that direction into a high-performing engineering organisation: bringing a strong technology point of view, shaping engineering choices, challenging where needed, creating alignment across teams, and ensuring strategy becomes measurable customer, technology and business outcomes.
* You will also be a senior leader within Retail Technology India, helping build a strong Bengaluru engineering community and ensuring our India teams operate as co-owners of outcomes rather than as a downstream delivery centre.
* Your success will be measured by the outcomes and leadership leverage created by the engineering organisation you lead - not by the number of decisions you personally make or issues you personally resolve.

What success looks like

* Everyday Banking has a strong Bengaluru engineering organisation that is trusted as a co-owner of customer, technology and business outcomes.
* Engineering leaders and senior engineers have clear accountability and decision rights; important decisions do not depend on one or two individuals.
* Teams deliver valuable change faster and more safely, with measurable improvement in flow, quality, reliability, resilience and developer experience.
* Technology health improves over time: operational risk, avoidable technical debt and legacy complexity reduce while reuse, automation and platform leverage increase.
* Bengaluru and Australia operate as one technology leadership system, with strong relationships, constructive challenge and shared accountability rather than a sender-receiver model.
* The organisation has a visible pipeline of future Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers and technology leaders, supported by deliberate succession and capability plans.
* AI-enabled engineering is adopted responsibly where it produces measurable improvement in engineering effectiveness or customer outcomes.
* Where the role owns delivery, commitments are met with appropriate transparency and discipline without trading away long-term technology health.

Key relationships

* Everyday Banking Domain Tech Lead / Technology General Manager
* General Manager, Retail Technology India
* Everyday Banking Crew Tech Leads and Engineering Leaders
* Product and Business leadership
* Chief / Principal / Staff Engineers and Architecture
* Retail Technology engineering and platform teams
* Cyber Security, Risk, Controls, Data and AI teams
Enterprise and shared technology services  

**Essential Skills:**

* Are experienced engineering leaders who have led large, complex organisations through other leaders, ideally at 100+ engineer scale.
* Combine strong people leadership with credible technology and engineering depth; you can operate from executive strategy and organisational design through to meaningful architecture and engineering discussions.
* Have built high-performing engineering organisations with strong DevSecOps, continuous delivery, automated quality, observability, reliability, resilience, security and operational ownership practices.
* Can translate customer and business priorities into engineering outcomes, measures and pragmatic technology choices rather than managing only activity, capacity or milestones.
* Have led technology modernisation and simplification in complex estates, including technical-debt reduction, platform evolution, integration simplification and legacy constraints.
* Understand modern software architecture, APIs and integration, cloud and platform engineering, distributed systems, data, security, privacy and resilience sufficiently to challenge and guide senior engineers and architects.
* Have a track record of building engineering leaders, creating succession and lifting capability at organizational scale - including managing under-performance and giving clear, actionable feedback.
* Can influence senior Product, Business and Technology stakeholders through genuine disagreement, making trade-offs visible and maintaining constructive relationships under delivery pressure.
* Are comfortable operating in a global, matrixed organisation with split functional and local accountabilities, and can create clarity where formal authority is distributed.
* Use data and engineering measures to improve flow, quality, reliability, developer experience, technology health and customer value.
* Can make difficult prioritization and investment trade-offs, balancing near-term outcomes with sustainable engineering and total cost of ownership.
* Are curious and pragmatic about AI and emerging technology, and can turn experimentation into responsible, measurable engineering value.
Lead with humility, courage and accountability, invite challenge, learn from setbacks and are willing to change their own leadership behavior as the organisation evolves.

**Job Description**
Operating Model and Decision Authority
  
  
**U.S. ownership.**
U.S.-based global process, product and service owners retain accountability for service strategy, policy, global process design, service scope, priorities, standards, technology roadmaps, funding decisions and approval of material changes.
  
  
**India execution.**
The India leader is accountable for building and managing the delivery capability and executing assigned services within approved processes, controls, service levels, budgets and delegated authority. The role has authority over day-to-day delivery management, work allocation, team capability, quality assurance and operational issue resolution within these boundaries.
  
  
**Change authority.**
The India leader recommends improvements and implements approved changes. Changes affecting policy, global process design, technology roadmaps or architecture, service scope or commitments, funding, key controls or risk acceptance require approval from the designated accountable owner.
  
  
Service Mandate
  
  

* Global HR services delivered from India

Assigned services supporting employees across approved geographies. U.S.-based owners set direction, policy, process and product standards; the India organisation manages execution and performance.
  
  

* India-local HR operations

Services supporting the India employee population under India HR leadership and designated local functional owners, consistent with global standards and applicable Indian requirements. Local decision rights will be assigned explicitly and will not be assumed to sit with either the U.S. or India delivery organisation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Delivery Strategy and Operating Model
* Build and lead the India delivery organisation within the operating model established by U.S.-based global HR owners and India HR leadership, as applicable.
* Implement and manage delivery against the approved service catalogue, service levels, KPIs, governance and escalation framework.
* Recommend operating-model, scope and service improvements to the designated accountable owner for approval.
* Build a scalable delivery capability that can support approved workforce growth and service expansion.
* Employee Lifecycle Operations
* Be accountable for delivery of the global HR services formally assigned to the India team, against approved scope, procedures, controls and service levels.
* Global delivery scope may include pre-boarding and onboarding; employee data and HR administration; position and organisation management; employee documentation; offboarding and exits; and approved HR product configuration and support activities.
* Be accountable for India-local HR operations within the authority delegated by India HR and designated functional owners. Scope may include payroll interface and payroll governance; benefits administration; leave and attendance administration; performance- and compensation-cycle administration; employee and manager query management; learning administration and delivery support; and recruiting operations and administration.
* Maintain clear hand-offs, escalation paths and accountability between the India delivery team, U.S.-based owners, HR COEs, HRBPs, India HR and business leaders.
* Service Excellence and Continuous Improvement
* Establish operational excellence disciplines across services delivered by the India organisation.
* Drive standardisation, simplification and elimination of manual work within approved process and control boundaries.
* Maintain delivery procedures consistent with approved global processes, service standards and country requirements. Develop local work instructions within delegated authority; obtain owner approval for changes to process design, policy interpretation or key controls.
* Monitor turnaround time, quality, productivity, backlog, capacity and customer experience; identify root causes and implement corrective action.
* Build and manage a continuous-improvement pipeline using Lean, Six Sigma or comparable methods. Recommend changes requiring owner approval.
* HR Product, Technology and Digital Enablement
* Partner with designated HR Product and Technology owners to optimise platforms such as Workday and ServiceNow.
* Execute approved configuration, testing, release and production-support activities against the U.S.-owned product roadmap and prioritised backlog, within established access, change and release controls.
* Identify opportunities to expand self-service, automate high-volume transactions and queries, and apply AI or workflow automation; provide operational requirements and implement approved solutions.
* Maintain data-quality controls and execute assigned data-governance responsibilities. Escalate systemic issues to the accountable data, process or product owner.
* Use analytics to identify service trends, capacity needs, quality issues and productivity opportunities.
* Governance, Risk and Compliance
* Execute assigned controls, maintain evidence and sustain audit readiness across delivered services.
* Ensure India-local operations comply with applicable Indian employment requirements and organisational policies; escalate interpretation questions to Legal, Compliance or the accountable policy owner.
* Identify operational risks and issues, implement approved remediation and escalate material matters through established governance.
* Obtain accountable-owner approval for material control changes, policy exceptions and risk-acceptance decisions.
* Maintain appropriate segregation of duties, access controls and approval controls.
* Service Performance and Analytics
* Monitor and report performance against agreed measures, including service-level achievement, turnaround time, first-contact resolution, query volumes, backlog, quality and error rates, employee and manager satisfaction, productivity, capacity utilisation, and operational risk and control indicators.
* Lead regular delivery-performance reviews with India HR leadership and designated U.S.-based owners.
* Provide transparent reporting on dependencies, capacity constraints, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Organisation, Capability and Capacity
* Build and lead a high-performing India HR Operations and Service Delivery organisation.
* Manage staffing deployment, skills, cross-training, capacity, business continuity and succession within approved budgets and workforce plans.
* Establish appropriate spans, layers and skill mix for effective service delivery.
* Escalate capacity constraints and recommend workforce or prioritisation adjustments required to meet agreed commitments.
* Build a service-oriented culture grounded in accountability, controls, continuous improvement and partnership.
* Transitions and Service Expansion
* Lead India delivery readiness, knowledge transfer, capacity preparation and stabilisation for transitions approved through global and India governance.
* Develop transition plans, readiness assessments, knowledge-transfer plans, controls validation and migration governance for the India delivery organisation.
* Recommend additional services suitable for delivery from India. Service scope, funding and go-live decisions remain with the designated accountable owners.
* Ensure transitioned services meet agreed exit criteria before moving from stabilisation to steady-state delivery.
* Vendor and Third-Party Delivery
* Manage day-to-day performance of assigned HR service partners and third parties within approved contracts and governance.
* Monitor agreed service levels and controls, resolve operational issues and escalate material performance or risk concerns.
* Recommend commercial, scope or performance improvements. Vendor selection, contracting, pricing and material scope changes remain with Procurement and designated accountable owners unless explicitly delegated.
* Execute assigned third-party risk management responsibilities and maintain required documentation.
* Stakeholder and Governance Leadership
* Act as the senior India delivery partner to India HR leadership, U.S.-based global HR leadership, HR Operations, HR COEs, HRBPs, HR Product and Technology, Finance, Legal, Risk and Compliance, Internal Audit and business leaders.
* For global services delivered from India, take functional direction on service scope, priorities, standards and commitments from the Head of S.O.S. and designated U.S.-based process, product and service owners.
* For India-local responsibilities, operate under India HR leadership and designated local functional owners.

* Lead with urgency: Take initiative, be decisive, set a winning pace and fight for every point.
* Strategic and ambitious: Aim high, think strategically, be externally oriented and comfortable with uncertainty and stretch.

title: HR Delivery Leader
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Operating Model and Decision Authority**
==========================================

**U.S. ownership.** U.S.-based global process, product and service owners retain accountability for service strategy, policy, global process design, service scope, priorities, standards, technology roadmaps, funding decisions and approval of material changes.

**India execution.** The India leader is accountable for building and managing the delivery capability and executing assigned services within approved processes, controls, service levels, budgets and delegated authority. The role has authority over day-to-day delivery management, work allocation, team capability, quality assurance and operational issue resolution within these boundaries.

**Change authority.** The India leader recommends improvements and implements approved changes. Changes affecting policy, global process design, technology roadmaps or architecture, service scope or commitments, funding, key controls or risk acceptance require approval from the designated accountable owner.

**Service Mandate**
===================

**A. Global HR services delivered from India**
----------------------------------------------

Assigned services supporting employees across approved geographies. U.S.-based owners set direction, policy, process and product standards; the India organisation manages execution and performance.

**B. India-local HR operations**
--------------------------------

Services supporting the India employee population under India HR leadership and designated local functional owners, consistent with global standards and applicable Indian requirements. Local decision rights will be assigned explicitly and will not be assumed to sit with either the U.S. or India delivery organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Delivery Strategy and Operating Model**
--------------------------------------------

* Build and lead the India delivery organisation within the operating model established by U.S.-based global HR owners and India HR leadership, as applicable.
* Implement and manage delivery against the approved service catalogue, service levels, KPIs, governance and escalation framework.
* Recommend operating-model, scope and service improvements to the designated accountable owner for approval.
* Build a scalable delivery capability that can support approved workforce growth and service expansion.

**2. Employee Lifecycle Operations**
------------------------------------

* Be accountable for delivery of the global HR services formally assigned to the India team, against approved scope, procedures, controls and service levels.
* Global delivery scope may include pre-boarding and onboarding; employee data and HR administration; position and organisation management; employee documentation; offboarding and exits; and approved HR product configuration and support activities.
* Be accountable for India-local HR operations within the authority delegated by India HR and designated functional owners. Scope may include payroll interface and payroll governance; benefits administration; leave and attendance administration; performance- and compensation-cycle administration; employee and manager query management; learning administration and delivery support; and recruiting operations and administration.
* Maintain clear hand-offs, escalation paths and accountability between the India delivery team, U.S.-based owners, HR COEs, HRBPs, India HR and business leaders.

**3. Service Excellence and Continuous Improvement**
----------------------------------------------------

* Establish operational excellence disciplines across services delivered by the India organisation.
* Drive standardisation, simplification and elimination of manual work within approved process and control boundaries.
* Maintain delivery procedures consistent with approved global processes, service standards and country requirements. Develop local work instructions within delegated authority; obtain owner approval for changes to process design, policy interpretation or key controls.
* Monitor turnaround time, quality, productivity, backlog, capacity and customer experience; identify root causes and implement corrective action.
* Build and manage a continuous-improvement pipeline using Lean, Six Sigma or comparable methods. Recommend changes requiring owner approval.

**4. HR Product, Technology and Digital Enablement**
----------------------------------------------------

* Partner with designated HR Product and Technology owners to optimise platforms such as Workday and ServiceNow.
* Execute approved configuration, testing, release and production-support activities against the U.S.-owned product roadmap and prioritised backlog, within established access, change and release controls.
* Identify opportunities to expand self-service, automate high-volume transactions and queries, and apply AI or workflow automation; provide operational requirements and implement approved solutions.
* Maintain data-quality controls and execute assigned data-governance responsibilities. Escalate systemic issues to the accountable data, process or product owner.
* Use analytics to identify service trends, capacity needs, quality issues and productivity opportunities.

**5. Governance, Risk and Compliance**
--------------------------------------

* Execute assigned controls, maintain evidence and sustain audit readiness across delivered services.
* Ensure India-local operations comply with applicable Indian employment requirements and organisational policies; escalate interpretation questions to Legal, Compliance or the accountable policy owner.
* Identify operational risks and issues, implement approved remediation and escalate material matters through established governance.
* Obtain accountable-owner approval for material control changes, policy exceptions and risk-acceptance decisions.
* Maintain appropriate segregation of duties, access controls and approval controls.

**6. Service Performance and Analytics**
----------------------------------------

* Monitor and report performance against agreed measures, including service-level achievement, turnaround time, first-contact resolution, query volumes, backlog, quality and error rates, employee and manager satisfaction, productivity, capacity utilisation, and operational risk and control indicators.
* Lead regular delivery-performance reviews with India HR leadership and designated U.S.-based owners.
* Provide transparent reporting on dependencies, capacity constraints, risks and improvement opportunities.

**7. Organisation, Capability and Capacity**
--------------------------------------------

* Build and lead a high-performing India HR Operations and Service Delivery organisation.
* Manage staffing deployment, skills, cross-training, capacity, business continuity and succession within approved budgets and workforce plans.
* Establish appropriate spans, layers and skill mix for effective service delivery.
* Escalate capacity constraints and recommend workforce or prioritisation adjustments required to meet agreed commitments.
* Build a service-oriented culture grounded in accountability, controls, continuous improvement and partnership.

**8. Transitions and Service Expansion**
----------------------------------------

* Lead India delivery readiness, knowledge transfer, capacity preparation and stabilisation for transitions approved through global and India governance.
* Develop transition plans, readiness assessments, knowledge-transfer plans, controls validation and migration governance for the India delivery organisation.
* Recommend additional services suitable for delivery from India. Service scope, funding and go-live decisions remain with the designated accountable owners.
* Ensure transitioned services meet agreed exit criteria before moving from stabilisation to steady-state delivery.

**9. Vendor and Third-Party Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Manage day-to-day performance of assigned HR service partners and third parties within approved contracts and governance.
* Monitor agreed service levels and controls, resolve operational issues and escalate material performance or risk concerns.
* Recommend commercial, scope or performance improvements. Vendor selection, contracting, pricing and material scope changes remain with Procurement and designated accountable owners unless explicitly delegated.
* Execute assigned third-party risk management responsibilities and maintain required documentation.

**10. Stakeholder and Governance Leadership**
---------------------------------------------

* Act as the senior India delivery partner to India HR leadership, U.S.-based global HR leadership, HR Operations, HR COEs, HRBPs, HR Product and Technology, Finance, Legal, Risk and Compliance, Internal Audit and business leaders.
* For global services delivered from India, take functional direction on service scope, priorities, standards and commitments from the Head of S.O.S. and designated U.S.-based process, product and service owners.
* For India-local responsibilities, operate under India HR leadership and designated local functional owners.
* Escalate conflicting priorities, capacity demands or unclear decision rights through the defined joint governance mechanism.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================

This leader is expected to consistently demonstrate the U.S. Bank Leadership Expectations in building the India delivery organisation, partnering across U.S. and India stakeholders, and delivering assigned services within the defined operating model and decision rights.

* **Operate like an owner:** Lead with a company-first mindset, own issues, and deliver results with a no-excuses mindset.
* **Lead with urgency:** Take initiative, be decisive, set a winning pace and fight for every point.
* **Strategic and ambitious:** Aim high, think strategically, be externally oriented and comfortable with uncertainty and stretch.
* **Customer at the center:** Commit to relentlessly improving outcomes for customers, both internal and external.
* **Communicate powerfully:** Communicate generously with clarity, candor, transparency and good judgment.
* **High-performing teams:** Build teams grounded in principles of performance excellence, trust, alignment, accountability and recognition.
* **U.S. Bank ambassadors:** Be visible with stakeholders and represent the company with positive confidence.
* **Unwavering integrity and ethical standards:** Conduct business as long-term stewards of the company’s trust and reputation.
* **Demonstrate genuine care:** Bring authentic care, respect and support to help each other thrive.

**Experience and Qualifications**
=================================

* 15+ years of progressive HR experience, including 7+ years in senior HR Operations, shared services or HR service delivery leadership.
* Experience in a Global Capability Centre, Global Business Services, shared-services or large multinational environment.
* Proven experience building or scaling an HR operations or service delivery organisation.
* Experience delivering services across complex employee populations and, preferably, multiple countries or regions.
* Strong understanding of hire-to-retire processes, service management, governance, controls, compliance and operational risk.
* Experience partnering with global process owners, product teams and technology teams, including Workday, ServiceNow or comparable platforms.
* Experience leading transitions, knowledge transfer, stabilisation and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing external vendors and service partners within enterprise governance.
* Strong analytical, data-driven and operational leadership capability.
* Excellent senior stakeholder management, influencing and escalation skills across matrixed organisations.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.
